answer: What survives to the garden is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the willow of the next round. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
